runtime.name: psionic-v41-stage/1+cuda
runtime.source_commit: 6e59f4de54 (chain, memory, answers, CPU); 5b0bd2d545 for the limit check

stage_worker.arch: sm_120, checked by the startup script against the GPU
stage_worker.arithmetic: CUDA device order (ReferenceBf16 reductions); CPU runs: ReferenceBf16Tp8

runtime.precision: FP8 E4M3 dense and FP4 E2M1 routed experts with UE8M0 scales; BF16 KV and indexer keys; F32 residual streams across boundaries

machine.gpus: 4 x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 101,973,819,392 bytes each (cudaMemGetInfo)
machine.launch: pylon cloud up one-quad --group v41-w3w2 --head stage0 --transport direct --temperature 0 --thinking off (the pre-#12408 spelling of --mode chat); after the Pylon answers the head was stopped and w3w2_vm.sh ran on the same machine

kv_and_indexer_bytes_per_position.sliding_window_layers (0, 1): a fixed 128-row ring per layer, 131,072 bytes
kv_and_indexer_bytes_per_position.note: a stage allocates every source its layers read, so sources 8 and 20 are held twice in a four-way split

step_buffers.served_rule: a group sends a prompt in one step, so each stage sizes them for its whole context: 1.51 GB at 8,192, 24.2 GB at 131,072; that, not the KV cache, bounds long contexts
step_buffers.served_max_prompt_tokens: 2,872 by #12408 (the 256 MiB codec at the layer-30 boundary, 93,459 bytes a prompt token)

active_parameters_per_decode_token.counted: every non-expert weight of each layer, 6 of 384 routed experts, the shared expert, the head, and one embedding row; Engram rows not included

w2.policy: G2 v2 is not frozen; these are designated assertions (scripts/bench/deepseek-v41/w2_answers.py), not a G2 v2 pass

checks.assertions: designated by scripts/bench/deepseek-v41/w2_answers.py; G2 v2's frozen task suite and quality budget are not yet defined
